deferred.reason: Without read-only production counter/tick observations, wall-time decay cannot establish independent counters. First-action threshold tests establish only per-route enforcement.
Ten-message bursts and sleeps do not prove an exact boundary with listener-tick decay.
No production read-only listener tick/counter instrumentation is available; game freeze does not freeze connection ticks.
Valid signatures and acknowledgments require an authentic session; no fabricated signature/ack evidence.
At a threshold of 20 the first post-deop action reaches the threshold by itself; this cannot establish how much operator debt was retained.
Membership bypass at operator level zero remains unverified by this runner.
Java integer overflow and existing unordered async handler/signature validation differences remain outside this bounded acceptance.

scope:
Five paired observable chat/command throttle cases on fresh offline connections.

Threshold one second = 20: the first unsigned trigger/chat effect precedes typed
disconnect.spam. Threshold zero: a 32-action burst, complete received processing
evidence and a subsequent positive client fence without disconnect. The same
workload must kick a fresh nonoperator under unmodified defaults. Operator command
bypass, then deop enforcement.
No exact 200-tick boundary, separate-budget, frozen-decay, signed-chat/command,
signature/ack-validation, or retained-debt amount claim is made.
